## Release Notes

Released on 2026-10-20.

This release addresses [GHSA-hq85-5cpj-mr62](https://github.com/astral-sh/uv/security/advisories/GHSA-hq85-5cpj-mr62), which involves a root CA whose intermediate on the Web PKI have been compromised. Users are encouraged to upgrade immediately, as well as confirm that all other software that uses bundled CAs is also properly updated.

### Preview features

- Validate PEP 825 variant metadata and treat package versions with invalid metadata as unavailable under `wheel-variants` ([#22512](https://github.com/astral-sh/uv/pull/22512))

### Other changes

- Update the bundled Mozilla root certificates via `webpki-root-certs` 1.0.10 ([#22760](https://github.com/astral-sh/uv/pull/22760))

## Install uv 0.13.4

### Install prebuilt binaries via shell script

```sh
curl --proto '=https' --tlsv1.2 -LsSf https://releases.astral.sh/github/uv/releases/download/0.13.4/uv-installer.sh | sh
```

### Install prebuilt binaries via powershell script

```sh
powershell -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -c "irm https://releases.astral.sh/github/uv/releases/download/0.13.4/uv-installer.ps1 | iex"
```

## Verifying GitHub Artifact Attestations

The artifacts in this release have attestations generated with GitHub Artifact Attestations. These can be verified by using the [GitHub CLI](https://cli.github.com/manual/gh_attestation_verify):
```sh
gh attestation verify <file-path of downloaded artifact> --repo astral-sh/uv
```

You can also download the attestation from [GitHub](https://github.com/astral-sh/uv/attestations) and verify against that directly:
```sh
gh attestation verify <file-path of downloaded artifact> --bundle <file-path of downloaded attestation>
```
